goal: Verify that a user can successfully create a new Site Host account, navigate the calendar to the previous month, and access the settings menu to adjust view preferences.
instructions: On the 'Create your account' page, enter 'alice' into the 'Username' field and 'SecureP@ss123!' into the 'Password' field, then click the 'Sign up' button.
Once logged in and viewing the calendar (initially showing June 2026), click the 'Previous month' button (left arrow icon) located next to the month title to navigate to May 2026.
Click the settings icon (gear symbol) located in the top right corner of the calendar header to open the view configuration menu.
success_criteria: The user is successfully redirected from the signup page to the main dashboard after clicking 'Sign up'.
The calendar view updates to display 'May 2026' after clicking the previous month navigation button.
A dropdown menu appears below the settings icon containing options for 'Shown time' and 'Order'.
The 'Order' dropdown within the settings menu is set to 'Newest first'.
